themes: Unseen beings exist but are not shown
summary_for_children: Al-Jinn tells that a group of jinn heard the Quran, found it amazing and believed. The jinn are never shown.
environment_concept: A night desert where an amazing Quran is heard by a group the eye cannot see; the world shows only stillness and a sky guarded with flames.
architecture_and_scenery: Night desert, sky with shooting stars.

activities.name: Shooting stars
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Jinn are unseen; nothing shows them.

status.playable_environment: not built: a shared symbolic setting stands in

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
